authorization.request: 用户要求 DSH Desktop 插件商城详情可查看，并提供安装、卸载、启动、关闭入口；未满足条件时显示禁用原因。用户明确要求完成功能后验证并上线。

objective: 修复 DSH Desktop 详情弹窗缺少生命周期操作区的问题；把按钮和禁用原因渲染在详情正文中，避免依赖 Desktop Modal 页脚插槽的显示行为。

change.desktopDetails: 对符合 Catalog 条件的条目按当前安装状态显示安装或启动/关闭/卸载按钮；当前 DSH 兼容性未知时在正文展示禁用安装按钮和原因。
change.safety: 保持现有精确 DSH 兼容性、固定 Commit、安装来源、官方 Bundle、商城自身和官方 pluginManager 门禁；禁用按钮不调用任何写接口。

gates: Bind the change to the current main Commit and exact file hashes; reject out-of-scope edits.
Verify matching installed bundles show their available lifecycle actions inside details; unknown compatibility shows a disabled Install action and an explicit reason.
Keep all real Desktop Profile and package changes out of this source PR; perform any later local update only through the official DSH plugin manager under a separate plan and confirmation.
Run repository checks and exact-head CI; publish through a CI-checked PR, then update the first-party Catalog to the merged fixed Commit in a separate fresh Catalog plan.

rollback.source: Revert only this exact 0.9.19 source change through a CI-checked PR.
rollback.desktopProfile: This source change does not alter the real Desktop Profile. Any later local plugin update remains a separate planned official-manager operation.

healthCheck: The DSH Desktop detail content tree exposes the status-appropriate operation buttons and compatibility/source gate reason; exact-head CI and a fresh Catalog/public readback pass after source merge.
